summary_1line: A virtuous fowler explains cosmology, the elements and their qualities, and teaches that mastering the senses through self-discipline leads to spiritual realization and liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A humble fowler calmly instructs a seated Brahmana beneath a forest tree while explaining the nature of the universe and the elements.
A symbolic chariot races forward as a charioteer struggles to rein in six wild horses representing the senses.
A meditating sage perceives his spirit expanding until it fills the cosmos, with stars and elements reflected within him.
